# [TASK] Implement Discovery Service (Eureka Server)

## Task
Standalone Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka Server, so other services can register and discover each other by name instead of hardcoded URLs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Eureka server starts on port 8761; dashboard and `/actuator/health` (UP) reachable
- [x] Runs standalone (`register-with-eureka: false`, `fetch-registry: false`) — it's the registry itself, not a client of another one
- [x] Other services (config-service, api-gateway, etc.) register and appear in the dashboard
- [x] Unit + integration tests passing (`DiscoveryServiceApplicationTests`, `EurekaServerIntegrationTest`)
- [x] Multi-stage Dockerfile builds

## Estimate
**Hours:** 4

## Notes
Implemented 2025-11-15 (`2b157a9`, `cf88012`, `e68d66e`, `beec72b`, `7b1209b`).
